name: Aaws Bhatta Sahayata Yojana
benefit: In Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, and Ujjain cities ₹2,000/- per student per month. At district headquarters ₹1,250/- per student per month. At the tehsil and development block level ₹1,000/- per student per month.
eligibility_rules: The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. The applicant must be admitted as a regular student in a government or recognized non-government college. The applicant must not be admitted to any government hostel. The annual income of the student's family must be as per the income limit prescribed in the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme, which is currently ₹6,00,000/- per annum. The college or the student's permanent residence should not be located within the geographical limits of the same local body (urban body/gram panchayat).
documents_required: th class mark sheet. Certificate of the class in which the student is studying. Certificate of Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe (the
category to which the student belongs).Passport size photograph. Bank account passbook.

Step-4: Fill in the required details accurately in the registration form.
